say:3:1410308001:0.text: Halt! I am Indris, Captain of the Sal'thorin Guard.
say:3:1410308001:0.source_cn: 你们几个，站住。我乃因度厄，艾塞勒一族的卫队长。

say:4:1410308002:1.text: You've been involved with a Sinned One. This matter touches upon our clan's deepest secrets. I cannot allow you to leave without consequences.
say:4:1410308002:1.source_cn: 你们参与了对孽化者的处理，此事涉及我族秘辛，我不能放你们走。

say:5:1410308003:1.text: Wait, are you talking about that kid turning into a monster before our eyes?
say:5:1410308003:1.source_cn: 你说的秘辛，是指那孩子在我们眼前变成了怪物？

say:6:1410308004:0.text: I've seen that before... I thought it was some rare underground species. Could it be... they were originally your people? An Essail?
say:6:1410308004:0.source_cn: 我曾见过那种怪物，我还以为是什么稀有的地下物种。难道…...

say:7:1410308005:1.text: ... I can't disclose that. But now you're involved.
say:7:1410308005:1.source_cn: ……我不便透露。但你们牵涉到了其中——

say:8:1410308006:1.text: You must come with me to <style="highlight">Sal'thorin</style>. The High Priestess will decide what happens next.

say:9:1410308007:1.text: That's a very suspicious request! We're not going anywhere with you!
say:9:1410308007:1.source_cn: 这么可疑的要求，我们才不会跟你走！

say:10:1410308008:1.text: Don't complicate things. I'd rather not resort to force.
say:10:1410308008:1.source_cn: 不要让事情变得复杂，我不想动手。

say:11:1410308009:0.text: Hey! What's with that tone? There are four of us here!
say:11:1410308009:0.source_cn: 喂，你什么口气啊……我们这里可是有4个人！

say:12:1410308010:1.text: So, you'd rather resolve this with violence?
say:12:1410308010:1.source_cn: 所以你们选择用武力解决问题？

say:13:1410308011:1.text: Wait, wait. Indris, you just said we'd be going to <style="highlight">Sal'thorin</style>, right?
say:13:1410308011:1.source_cn: 停——这位小哥，你刚才说，要带我们去<style=hi...

choice_prompt:14:1410308011.text: Wait, wait. Indris, you just said we'd be going to <style="highlight">Sal'thorin</style>, right?
choice_prompt:14:1410308011.source_cn: 停——这位小哥，你刚才说，要带我们去<style=highlight>萨洛克兰</style>？

say:15:1410308012:0.text: The place where my people reside. It's a sanctuary untouched by conflict, pain, or corruption.
say:15:1410308012:0.source_cn: 我族居住的地方名为萨洛克兰。那是远离纷争、痛苦和污秽的...

say:16:1410308013:1.text: I'm simply following protocol. There's no reason to be nervous. The High Priestess is merciful and kind...
say:16:1410308013:1.source_cn: 我也是例行公事，你们无需紧张。祭司冕下宽容慈爱……

say:17:1410308014:1.text: And given the special contributions the dwarves have made to our people, she'll certainly not be harsh with you.
say:17:1410308014:1.source_cn: 再加上矮人一族为我族做出的特殊贡献，她绝不会刁难你们。

choice_prompt:18:1410308014.text: And given the special contributions the dwarves have made to our people, she'll certainly not be harsh with you.
choice_prompt:18:1410308014.source_cn: 再加上矮人一族为我族做出的特殊贡献，她绝不会刁难你们。

say:19:1410308015:0.text: I-Indris, can we have a moment to discuss this?
say:19:1410308015:0.source_cn: 因、因度厄小哥，你稍等，我们商量商量。

say:21:1410308016:1.text: Very well. I'll wait here. But don't even think about running.
say:21:1410308016:1.source_cn: 可以，我在一旁等候。别想着逃跑。

narration:23:1410308017:0.text: Indris steps a few paces away, but his eyes remain firmly locked on the group...
narration:23:1410308017:0.source_cn: 因度厄走远了几步，他的双眼仍然紧紧锁视着众人……

say:25:1410308018:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, actually, I was planning to take you to Sal'thorin myself. There's a <style="highlight">lift that leads to the surface</style> from there.
say:25:1410308018:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, actually, I was planning to take you to Sal'thorin myself. There's a <style="highlight">lift that leads to the surface</style> from there.
say:25:1410308018:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, actually, I was planning to take you to Sal'thorin myself. There's a <style="highlight">lift that leads to the surface</style> from there.

say:26:1410308019:1.text: Zanie... I'm not sure I can trust you.
say:26:1410308019:1.source_cn: 祖娅……我不确定该不该相信你。

say:27:1410308020:0.text: You heard what that guy said, right? <style="highlight">The dwarves have made special contributions to the Essail</style>.
say:27:1410308020:0.source_cn: 你们肯定听到了，那位因度厄先生说<style=high...

say:29:1410308022:1.text: You definitely know more than you're letting on.
say:29:1410308022:1.source_cn: 祖娅，刚才看你的表情，你肯定知道些什么。

say:30:1410308023:1.text: What's your connection to them? And what really happened to bring us down here? If you don't explain, how can we trust you? This is important because...
say:30:1410308023:1.source_cn: 你们之间的关系，还有我们掉落下来这一系列事情，如果不解...

choice_prompt:31:1410308023.text: What's your connection to them? And what really happened to bring us down here? If you don't explain, how can we trust you? This is important because...
choice_prompt:31:1410308023.source_cn: 你们之间的关系，还有我们掉落下来这一系列事情，如果不解释清楚，我们很难相信你！

say:32:1410308024:0.text: Oh, wow. From the Lightbearer Empire?
say:32:1410308024:0.source_cn: 耀光来的？地表上那群矮人到底做了什么啊？

say:33:1410308025:0.text: What on Esperia did those surface dwarves do to provoke you?

say:34:1410308027:0.text: Anyway, I can assure you, everything is not what you think. There are things I can't tell you yet, but I'll say this much.
say:34:1410308027:0.source_cn: 总之，我先保证，一切跟你们想的都不一样！有些东西我不能...

say:35:1410308028:1.text: Sal'thorin, the royal city of the Essail, was built by my fellow dwarves.
say:35:1410308028:1.source_cn: 萨洛克兰，艾塞勒生活的那座王城，是我的同胞们所建。

say:36:1410308029:1.text: Wait, built by dwarves? You guys and the Essail are that close?
say:36:1410308029:1.source_cn: 哎？竟然是矮人建的吗？你们两个族群的关系这么密切！

say:37:1410308030:1.text: Well, it's not a big deal. We've built so many things throughout the years. Without my people, the Lightbearer Empire could never have been constructed.
say:37:1410308030:1.source_cn: 不至于不至于！这算不上大事。整个耀光的建设都离不开我的同族。

say:38:1410308031:1.text: Like building bridges in the east a thousand years ago, digging rivers in the west eight hundred years ago...
say:38:1410308031:1.source_cn: 什么一千年前在东边帮人家造过桥，八百年前在西边帮人家挖...

say:39:1410308032:1.text: And yes, building houses underground for certain individuals three hundred years ago. It's all a part of business, really. Hardly worth mentioning.
say:39:1410308032:1.source_cn: 三百年前在地底下帮人家盖个房子，这种没有什么技术含量的...

say:40:1410308033:1.text: If that's the case, why are you being so evasive?
say:40:1410308033:1.source_cn: 既然如此，为什么你支支吾吾的？

say:41:1410308034:1.text: The Essail are reclusive and don't like outsiders. We've got to respect our clients' wishes and not reveal their whereabouts.
say:41:1410308034:1.source_cn: 艾塞勒一族在地下隐居，不想被打扰。本着守信的原则，我们...

say:42:1410308035:1.text: I don't think it's that simple. You're hiding something, aren't you?
say:42:1410308035:1.source_cn: 我看没那么简单，一定还有别的理由。

say:43:1410308036:1.text: Fine. They've had some... minor collaborations with my people. But that's all I can say!
say:43:1410308036:1.source_cn: 呃，他们和我的同胞还有一些小小的合作。这个就不便透露了！

say:44:1410308037:1.text: But don't worry, since we've allied with the Lightbearer Empire, I assure you—there's no betrayal of the Empire's interests. Most dwarves are well aware of that.
say:44:1410308037:1.source_cn: 但放心，既然已经加入了耀光，背叛帝国利益的事肯定不能做...

say:45:1410308038:1.text: Anyway, I was originally going to sneak you into Sal'thorin, but with Indris offering to guide us, we can enter openly!
say:45:1410308038:1.source_cn: 言归正传，本来我打算带你们潜入萨洛克兰……现在有因度厄...

say:46:1410308039:1.text: Is that city really hard to get into?

say:47:1410308040:1.text: The Essail don't like dealing with outsiders, and they're masters of magic! The royal city is usually sealed tight.
say:47:1410308040:1.source_cn: 艾塞勒不喜欢和外人打交道，还会魔法！那座王城封闭得很……

say:48:1410308041:1.text: I've even been turned away a couple of times myself!
say:48:1410308041:1.source_cn: 有好几次，就连我都吃了闭门羹！

say:50:1410308043:1.text: Of course! How else would I know about the lift? So, what do you say, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Should we follow him?
say:50:1410308043:1.source_cn: 那肯定啊，不然我怎么知道那里有升降机！<style=s...
say:50:1410308043:1.male: Of course! How else would I know about the lift? So, what do you say, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Should we follow him?
say:50:1410308043:1.female: Of course! How else would I know about the lift? So, what do you say, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Should we follow him?

choice_prompt:51:1410308043.text: Of course! How else would I know about the lift? So, what do you say, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Should we follow him?
choice_prompt:51:1410308043.source_cn: 那肯定啊，不然我怎么知道那里有升降机！<style=stress><player_name></style><male>小弟</male><female>小妹</female>，怎么说，要不要先跟着他走？
choice_prompt:51:1410308043.male: Of course! How else would I know about the lift? So, what do you say, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Should we follow him?
choice_prompt:51:1410308043.female: Of course! How else would I know about the lift? So, what do you say, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Should we follow him?

say:52:1410308044:1.text: A whole city of the underground dwellers... I'd love to see it too.
say:52:1410308044:1.source_cn: 地下住民的王城啊……其实我也很想去看看。
say:52:1410308044:1.male: A whole city of the underground dwellers... I'd love to see it too.
say:52:1410308044:1.female: A whole city of the underground dwellers... I'd love to see it too.

say:53:1410308047:0.text: Alright, let's follow him for now. When the time comes, I'll figure things out. If it comes to it, we'll fight our way out. I'll find you a way to get back to the surface!
say:53:1410308047:0.source_cn: 先这么定了！到时候，我会视情况随机应变。实在不行就跟他...

choice:51:0:1.text: Alright, I'd like to see the city.
choice:51:0:1.source_cn: 就当见识一下萨洛克兰了
choice:51:0:1.male: Alright, I'd like to see the city.
choice:51:0:1.female: Alright, I'd like to see the city.

say:61:1410308045:0.text: That's right! The general's still waiting for us!
say:61:1410308045:0.source_cn: 没错，霍根将军还在等着我们呢！
say:61:1410308045:0.male: That's right! The general's still waiting for us!
say:61:1410308045:0.female: That's right! The general's still waiting for us!

choice:51:1:2.text: We don't have any other choice.
choice:51:1:2.source_cn: 反正回去只有这一条路
choice:51:1:2.male: We don't have any other choice.
choice:51:1:2.female: We don't have any other choice.

say:62:1410308046:1.male: What? Well, I guess he's an interesting dude...
say:62:1410308046:1.female: What? Well, I guess he's an interesting dude...

choice:51:2:3.source_cn: 我对因度厄倒是有些兴趣

choice:31:0:1.source_cn: 我们其实是耀光的特使

say:63:1410308026:0.source_cn: 怎么可能？！我们对那些事情才没兴趣！

choice:31:1:2.text: Do the dwarves want a rebellion?
choice:31:1:2.source_cn: 你们矮人要对耀光不利？
choice:31:1:2.male: Do the dwarves want a rebellion?
choice:31:1:2.female: Do the dwarves want a rebellion?
